items.titleEn: Russian Deputy President Putin and Trump discussed bilateral and Ukrainian issues
items.summaryEn: The US-Russian leaders end their meeting. President Trump and Russian President Putin met at the International Exchange Center in Shenzhen during the Asia-Pacific Organization summit. According to the Russian satellite news agency, Putin said he was happy to meet with Trump. According to reports, Russian Assistant to the President Ushakov said that this was a good meeting to discuss the preparations for the Sino-US-Russian Trilateral Summit, as well as some issues related to Russian-US bilateral relations, and to discuss directly the issue of Ukraine. He said that the meeting was not long, about 35 to 40 minutes, and that after the meeting, Putin was in a good mood. I'm not going to lie.

items.titleEn: APEC leaders met for about an hour
items.summaryEn: The Russian president met for about an hour. President Trump met with Russian President Vladimir Putin during an informal meeting of the leaders of the Asia-Pacific Organization in Shenzhen. Trump said before the meeting that he had a very good relationship with Putin and looked forward to a fruitful dialogue. Trump also said that the two sides have had good relations over the years. He has known Putin for a long time and believes that this meeting will bring a lot of good results, or at least open up some great chapters. He believes that these results will finally come true. Putin said he was happy to meet Trump. This meeting in Shenzhen is the first face-to-face meeting between the two sides since the summit in Alaska in August last year. I'm not going to lie.
